item.title: Accepting Failure: After Giving It My All
item.description:
This post discusses about the recent emotional deterioration that I faced. If you are currently undergoing a challenge, I sincerely wish you to cheer up!

The Disqualification

You may wonder: how big of a challenge can a high school student face? Well, I believe regardless of age, it is natural for people to face emotional challenges from events like failing an exam, receiving rejections, and breaking-up with the significant other. Maybe when I return to this post few years later this could be not much of a big deal. But as a student who loves math and had been preparing an exam for a quite a while, disqualifying from the second stage of team selection for the IMO (International Mathematical Olympiad) hit me hard.

item.title: Building My Blog With Hugo and GitHub
item.description: When I first decided to write my blog, I was thrown into bunch of options. I noticed that wordpress.com and medium are popular options when it comes to writing blogs. However, I also noticed that many of the popular options would generally give less control over my blog and require payments to use many of its features. So it became a natural choice for me to just build one myself, which was both a dumb and greatest choice that I ever made. Maybe I can save this for later blogs.
